criteria.name: Conflict intensity trends
criteria.description: Track how the frequency and severity of battles and political violence evolve over time, noting periods of escalation and any temporary declines.

criteria.name: Geographic spread of violence
criteria.description: Assess how fighting and insecurity expand or contract across zones and urban centers, identifying hotspots and shifts in conflict locations.

criteria.name: Civilian targeting patterns
criteria.description: Examine trends in violence against civilians, including how such incidents rise and fall in tandem with battles and which types of actors are implicated.

criteria.name: Criminality amid conflict
criteria.description: Evaluate the growth of criminal activities such as kidnappings and robberies that exploit weakened security, and how these intersect with insurgency dynamics.

criteria.name: Fragmentation of armed groups
criteria.description: Analyze the degree of factionalization within insurgent forces and how lack of centralized command contributes to indiscipline, civilian harm, and criminal behavior.

criteria.name: State security capacity
criteria.description: Assess changes in the government’s ability to protect civilians and maintain order, including the effectiveness of security operations and emergency measures.

criteria.name: Exposure and humanitarian impact
criteria.description: Identify the scale of population exposure to conflict and the knock-on effects on daily life, such as access to services, markets, education, and displacement risks.

criteria.name: Trigger events and public backlash
criteria.description: Monitor incidents that catalyze public outrage and protests, and evaluate how authorities respond and whether such episodes recur or spread.

criteria.name: Narratives and blame dynamics
criteria.description: Examine competing claims by government and insurgent actors about responsibility for insecurity, and how these narratives shape perceptions and legitimacy.

criteria.name: Comparative regional parallels
criteria.description: Draw parallels with similar insurgencies in other regions to contextualize patterns of fragmentation, civilian targeting, and criminal opportunism.

criteria.name: Humanitarian worker and refugee risks
criteria.description: Track threats to aid personnel and refugees, including targeted attacks and abductions, and how protection measures affect these trends.

criteria.name: Conflict-financing mechanisms
criteria.description: Assess how armed and affiliated groups fund operations through illicit means, and how intensifying conflict creates opportunities for self-financing.

criteria.name: Temporal correlation of events
criteria.description: Evaluate how spikes in battles correlate with increases in civilian harm and criminal incidents, identifying causal linkages and feedback loops.

criteria.name: Governance erosion indicators
criteria.description: Identify signs of breakdown in local security and administrative structures, and how governance gaps enable non-state actors and criminal groups.

criteria.name: Prospects for de-escalation
criteria.description: Consider the presence or absence of dialogue channels, confidence-building measures, and conditions necessary for stabilizing trends or negotiated outcomes.
